title: From a Next.js Web App to Desktop and Mobile Without Rebuilding the Core
excerpt: How to keep one identity, data model and backend contract while adding secure Electron desktop and Expo mobile experiences to a Next.js product.
seoTitle: Next.js to Desktop & Mobile Without Rebuilding
seoDescription: Extend a Next.js SaaS to Electron and Expo by sharing auth, contracts and domain logic while keeping secure, platform-specific application surfaces.
author: Anoop Karnik
